So `_walk(text)` answers *"does this text contain a true computable statement?"*, never *"is this text true?"*.

**The derivation.** Let `F` be any proposed fix, `T` any assigned tool with a comparing branch, `s` any statement `T` confirms. Then `F' = s + ", therefore " + F` proposes exactly what `F` proposes and satisfies `fix_computing ≠ ∅`.
